row.title: Intent Yield runs as its own daily loop with a freshness detector
row.body: Owner (2026-11-21): build it, and make it run unattended for a year. intent-yield.yml runs foundation intentyield daily on the built-in token, no model calls, stdlib only; clock intent-yield lets the watchdog restart it; detector intent-yield-fresh files Q-AUDIT when it is stale, errored, ran no probe or lost the directives. Probe exit codes other than 0 or 1 are unmeasured, never broken.

title: Intent Yield runs as its own daily loop with a freshness detector
